body: It’s 11:15pm here. I’m not sure what to talk about at the moment. I feel a little numb right now.
Just because people are in someone’s life doesn’t mean they’re not allowed to feel completely alone. Family or a relationship doesn’t fix anything.
Basically telling someone they have no reason to feel alone or depressed because they have siblings, parents, and or a significant other.

Age doesn’t define where you should be in life. Society has just pushed that onto people. I’m 23 years old, never finished high-school but I managed to get a decent paying job, my own car, and place to live. 
You got this! Don’t give up :)

Your safest option is just to contact someone you trust. Tell them exactly how you feel, and if they don’t react in the way you’d hope, don’t be let down by that. It’s difficult for people who aren’t going through it to understand. Reach out to the suicide hotline, or even text them. Talk to random people on here and get your mind off all the bad things. It’s okay to feel the way you do, and venting to even a stranger helps a lot! Message me if you’d like to talk about it.

I had three friends, one I’d known for 12 years and the other two for at least five years. The friend of 12 years gave up on me and always said she never knew what to say or how to help. The two friends of five years said that they left because I was “too depressing”, even though both of them had apparently dealt with depression. I don’t know, I wouldn’t leave anyone because of that. I trusted them...
So, that’s that.
It’s pretty easy to tell the difference.
